title: Trial to Reduce Hospitalizations in Children With Medical Complexity
brief_summary: The investigators hypothesize that an intervention, within an established patient-centered medical home, aimed at reducing modifiable risks for hospitalization, can decrease hospital utilization among medically complex children.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Children ages 0 to 17 years old who are enrolled in the Pediatric Medical Home Program at UCLA
* English and Spanish-speaking only

Exclusion Criteria:

* Children older than 17 years old who are enrolled in the Pediatric Medical Home Program
* Non-English and Non-Spanish speakers
